title: 第一卷 第1章 全名爬山 S级天赋
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“恭喜你获得S级天赋，铭刻之主！”

“检测到三千五百四十一位求生者开启了系统外挂，强制抹杀！”

“开启第二次检测，检测到三位隐藏系统外挂，强制抹杀！”

“开启第三次检测，检测到零位系统外挂着，游戏正式开始！”

秦龙有点不敢相信脑中的声音。

随后看向了自己刚刚抽取的天赋！

天赋：铭刻之主！S级！

铭刻之主：每天都有一次机会可以在任何物品上面铭刻一个特性，特性随机，即时生效！同一物品可二次铭刻，覆盖原有特性，每升级五级木屋，可增加一个每日铭刻次数！

揉了揉眼睛，再一次确认。

没错，就是S级天赋！

自己祈祷之中，能有个A级或者B级就已经是烧高香了。

毕竟自己从来不是什么欧皇的，运气也是一般。

怎么就给了一个S级的天赋！

最高等级天赋！

秦龙看向了自己的面板！

天赋：铭刻之主（S级）

寿元：未知

三分钟之前，脑海之中同样的声音响起过。

“欢迎来到全民求生！”

“这是一个丧尸的世界，重复，这是一个丧尸横行的山之世界。”

“山顶才是你们能够逆转未来的关键！”

“保护好你们的移动木屋，采集资源，努力升级，那将是你们赖以生存的东西！”

“每天必须爬山一公里最少，否则等待你们的只有死亡！”

“夜晚不是属于你们的，猎人可能会变成猎物！”

“每个人都有一条专属自己的上山路，不过它也有可能和别的路相交！”

“每天开门都将在不同的环境当中，除非你有特殊道具！”

“善用、善用、善用你们的手环，那是生存下去的根本！”

“剩下的具体详情，请仔细

“三分钟后，将开启本命天赋的抽取，每个人都有一次机会。”

“天赋分为五个等级，S、A、B、C、D，祝你好运，好的天赋能让你更好的活着！”

这就是刚刚来到这里时，脑海之中的声音。

自己得到了S级最高天赋！

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Congratulations on obtaining the S-level talent, Lord of Engraving!"

"It has been detected that 3,541 survivors have activated system cheats and will be forcibly wiped out!"

"Start the second detection and detect three hidden system plug-ins. Forced erasure!"

"Start the third test and detect that the zero system is hanging. The game officially begins!"

Qin Long couldn't believe the voice in his head.

Then he looked at the talent he had just extracted!

Talent: Lord of Inscription!S level!

Lord of Engraving: You have a chance to engrave a characteristic on any item every day. The characteristic is random and takes effect immediately!The same item can be engraved twice, overwriting the original characteristics. Every five-level wooden house upgrade can increase the number of daily inscriptions!

He rubbed his eyes and confirmed again.

That's right, it's an S-level talent!

In my prayers, it would be a blessing to have an A or B grade.

After all, I have never been a European emperor, and my luck is average.

Why was he given an S-level talent!

The highest level talent!

Qin Long looked at his panel!

Talent: Lord of Inscription (S level)

Shouyuan: unknown

Three minutes ago, the same voice sounded in my head.

"Welcome to Survival for All!"

"This is a zombie world, repeat, this is a zombie-infested mountain world."

"The top of the mountain is the key to your ability to reverse the future!"

"Protect your mobile wooden houses, collect resources, and work hard to upgrade them. That will be what you rely on for survival!"

"You must climb the mountain at least one kilometer every day, otherwise only death awaits you!"

"The night does not belong to you, the hunter may become the prey!"

"Everyone has his or her own path up the mountain, but it may also intersect with other paths!"

"Every day you open the door, you will be in a different environment, unless you have special props!"

"Make good use of, make good use of, make good use of your bracelets, that is the basis for survival!"

"Please pay careful attention to the remaining specific details.

“In three minutes, the extraction of natal talents will begin, and everyone will have a chance."

"Talents are divided into five levels, S, A, B, C, D. I wish you good luck, good talents can make you live a better life!"

This was the voice in my head when I first came here.

I got the highest S-level talent!
